name: Codespaces host storage tuning
description: Tunes the network-backed storage stack under the docker root of the Codespaces VM host (readahead, FUSE queue depth, noatime, dirty-page limits) and optionally prefetches the working set into the host's local cache. Runs on the host through the host's docker socket (bind-mounted by this Feature; no docker CLI needed, compatible with docker-in-docker) at every container start. Disabled unless the ENABLE_STORAGE_TUNING / ENABLE_STORAGE_PREWARM secrets are set.

dockerSocket.description: Path inside the container of the host's docker socket. This Feature bind-mounts the host's /var/run/docker.sock at /var/run/docker-host.sock; change this only if your configuration already mounts the host socket somewhere else.

helperImage.description: Image for the throw-away privileged helper container; it only needs `nsenter`. Empty means: reuse this dev container's own image (no pull).

warmReaders.description: Parallel O_DIRECT readers used by the prewarm (apply-tunables.py --readers).

timeoutSeconds.description: Kill the host-side run after this many seconds (0 disables). Interrupting it is harmless; the prewarm simply stops early.
